segments.line: It starts on a Saturday. The
controller doesn't plug into anything. It doesn't even have batteries.
But when you press the first code on the list, just to see,
something chimes. And right in front of your face, in glowing letters only you can see:
poke your arm with a fork. Nothing. You
drop a dictionary on your foot. Nothing. Not even a red mark. You
throw yourself down all fourteen stairs, on purpose. It doesn't even tickle. The
rules are on the back of the list, in tiny, old handwriting.
One. A cheat stays on until you enter the same code again.
Two. Nobody else can see the letters. And
three. Never, ever enter the last code.
Under all the scribbles, there's one word. You can't quite read it. Not yet.
